data_label: Source data documented as synthetic (dummy) in the Data Context & Relationship Diagram; not operational performance.
checksum_scope: Checksums establish consistency with the audit baseline of 2026-11-04, not authenticity against organiser-issued checksums.

original_rows.definition: All PR PO source rows, unchanged.
original_rows.limitation: If repeated rows are copies of one document line, counts, quantities and amounts are overstated.

exact_distinct_rows.definition: First occurrence of each group of rows identical in all 18 source columns.
exact_distinct_rows.limitation: If repeated rows are real separate transactions, counts, quantities and amounts are understated. This is a sensitivity scenario, not a correction of the data.

scenario_a.limitation: If identical rows are accidental copies of one event, demand is overstated.

scenario_b.definition: Eligible Movement records, excluding later occurrences of rows identical in all 7 source columns (rule C1).
scenario_b.limitation: If identical rows are real separate issues, demand is understated.

copy_rules.E5: Unit equals the material's unit in dim_material
copy_rules.C1: Identical to an earlier row in all 7 source columns. Earliest occurrence stays in Scenario B
copy_rules.gap classes: repeat_adjacent: gap of 1 row. repeat_near: gap of 2 to 10 rows. repeat_far: gap above 10 rows. Descriptive only

policies.no_default: No view or scenario is the default, and none is the true value.
